QuestInfo.name: Asking Perion for Help
QuestInfo.0: #p800018# in the #m80002000# seems to have another favor.
QuestInfo.1: This time, #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked me to deliver a letter to #p511# in #m10004000#.

0.0: Hmm... As expected, #p202# is weighing both the pros and cons of the Free Market. I suppose it's only natural for an elder leading a whole town to have his worries. But looking at the contents of this letter, it seems like he's leaning towards a positive view, thankfully.
0.1: So, could you deliver this letter to #p511# in #m10004000# this time? #m10004000# is another incredibly important town when it comes to developing this place.

1.0: What brings you to see me? Ah, #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked you to deliver this letter to me, I see. Let me take a look.

item.0: What brings you to see me? You say #p800018# in the #m80002000# asked you to deliver a letter to me? But where exactly is this letter?

lost.0: Oh, it looks like you lost my letter. Well, it happens. I'll write you a new one, so please try not to lose it this time.
